name: The Whispering Library of Forgotten Raindrops
description: An ancient library built from rain-soaked stone books, shelves floating with droplets that emit soft murmurs, a grand reading chair that floats, and a window showing a sky where raindrops form letters.
prompt: Old library with shelves made of rain-soaked stone, books levitating, each book emitting faint glowing droplets that drift and whisper, a floating reading chair in the center, view through a window showing a sky where falling raindrops form luminous letters, warm lamplight, magical realism, highly detailed.
caption: Let the forgotten raindrops read you a story 🌧️📚 Step into a library where every drop holds a secret.
